0022600105.text: The Cavaliers (0-1) host the Brooklyn Nets (0-1) with both teams looking for their first win after a single game each, and Cleveland is third in the Central, one game back, while Brooklyn sits fourth in the Atlantic, 1.5 games back. Brooklyn is without Tyler Bilodeau, who is out with a shoulder injury, and Cleveland has no players listed as unavailable. The Cavaliers won the 2025-26 season series 3-0 and beat the Nets 106-102 in Brooklyn in their last meeting on March 1, 2026, and no games have been played yet between the teams this season.
